## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Lint passes (ruff)
- [ ] Format check passes
- [ ] plugins/dso/scripts/append_review_cycle.py exists and is importable
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-append-review-cycle.sh exists and is executable
- [ ] Append preserves prior cycles[] entries
- [ ] Append on artifact without cycles[] initializes to [] (lazy migration)
- [ ] Other artifact keys preserved unchanged after append
- [ ] draft_hash field stored from --draft-hash CLI value
- [ ] CLI rejects unknown verdict values with non-zero exit
- [ ] bash tests/scripts/test-append-review-cycle.sh → PASS
- [ ] ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/append_review_cycle.py → PASS
